patch_description: The key bottleneck is initialization diversity: all seeds derive from two order-3 lattice layouts. The new program adds three seed families: (1) electrostatic repulsion layouts (points pushed apart inside the triangle via deterministic force iterations), (2) golden-ratio asymmetric low-discrepancy jitter layouts, (3) original lattice seeds. Each seed is refined by a faster annealer with an adaptive temperature schedule (T0=0.02 geometric decay to 1e-5) and a cheap local coordinate-descent polish pass at the end that tries small axis-aligned moves on the bottleneck point only, which is where the last gains typically come from. Vectorized area computation and cached triples keep eval time low. More diverse seeds plus the polish stage raise min_area while staying within a few seconds.
